name: @grapix/playout-desktop
description: GrapiX Playout desktop shell (Tauri 2 + WebView2). Supervises the render engine and the control service.

scripts.dev: npm --prefix ../../.. run build -w @grapix/playout-control && cargo build --manifest-path ../../../services/render-engine/Cargo.toml && tauri dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix ../../.. run build -w @grapix/playout-control && cargo build --release --manifest-path ../../../services/render-engine/Cargo.toml && tauri build
